notes.title: Join Us for the Hejstos Early Access! 0.15 version
notes.content:
Hello there,

We're thrilled to announce the launch of Hejstos Early Access, starting with version 0.15!

[h2]What is Hejstos?[/h2]

Hejstos is not just a game—it's a collaborative project designed to enhance your gaming experience. Here's how it works:

[list]
[*] We release a segment of the game.
[*] You provide feedback on what you enjoy, what needs improvement, and what you'd like to see next.
[*] We refine and expand the game based on your input, then release the next segment.
[/list]

[h2]Game Focus[/h2]

Hejstos combines dynamic combat with intriguing exploration.

The NPCs and the storyline are reserved for Farathan. This early access phase is crucial for perfecting all game mechanics, ensuring that Farathan will be exactly as you wish when the game is fully released.

[h2]Who We Are[/h2]

We're a passionate indie family studio, deeply committed to the RPG genre and dedicated to creating immersive experiences. We don't rely on traditional marketing; instead, we focus on real-time development, allowing players to experience improvements as they happen.

[h2]Join the Journey[/h2]

As followers and fans of the genre, your involvement is invaluable. We're eager to listen and adapt based on your feedback.

Thank you for your time, and we hope you enjoy every stage of the game. If there’s anything missing, don’t hesitate to let us know.

Have a great day!

P.S we will add more languages in the following month.

notes.title: FAQ - for discord community
notes.content:
[h2]Short version:[/h2]

Hejstos is being created because earlier, probably 80% of you reported that you do not want early access for Farathan because you do not want to spoiler the plot and the world.

Hejstos is focused on an adventure in the style of Souls games, we go forward to achieve goal X, kill a lot of monsters, explore, upgrade the character and weapons.

All the mechanics that we make together in Hejstos will be transferred one to one to Farathan. The world will change, the main character will change, and a plot will be added.

So, all the work that we do together here, aims to make playing Farathan enjoyable.
Early Access is for you. We work so that sooner or later you have in the game everything you like, just the way you like it.

[h2]Hejstos FAQ[/h2]

Early Access Principles – Early Access is for you. We work so that sooner or later you have everything you like in the game, just the way you like it.

Some mechanics will simply be added – upon a simple request. Some will be added after conducting a survey. The exception is things that do not fit the world of the game. For example, we will never add tanks 😉

We want to cooperate with you; we work for you. So you can be at ease. There's no developer vs. players here. This RPG is meant to delight us all. If something doesn't fit, just write about it. I've been playing myself for 28 years, mostly as a warrior, so I would especially ask mages for help.

This project will not be massively advertised, certainly not until the release. So some things may take longer. We are a 2-person team with little experience, please remember that. What for example the Reds can do in a month, we need 7 years for.

For the more inquisitive, a formula:

300 employees x 8 hours x 21 working days in a month = 50400 working hours

2 enthusiasts x 12 hours x 25 working days in a month = 600 working hours
50400 / 600 = 84. 84 months is 7 years.

And we still need to make a living. So report your needs. We will try to implement them as much as we can.

[h2]About Hejstos[/h2]

Hejstos is being created because earlier, probably 80% of you reported that you do not want early access to Farathan because you do not want to spoil the plot and the world.

So, we're using the vastness of our world and moved to the other end of the continent, embodying a different hero.

On this page, there is a small narrative trailer about the adventure Ortank embarks on.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2628930/Tales_of_Anturia_Hejstos/

I also encourage you to read the short book
It will be as a free DLC to the game by default, and now it's in #books on our discord

At the start, there will be a mage character who explains where we are, why we are there, and what our goal is. 

For the rest of the game, the hero will mostly talk to himself (to you), as this is a hostile wasteland.

We don't have either the money or the time to write another RPG with dialogues and an elaborate plot. Therefore, Hejstos is focused on an adventure in the style of Souls games, we go forward to achieve goal X, kill a lot of monsters, push our way through wherever possible, upgrade the character and weapon.

We polish every mechanic without spoilers so that you would be satisfied.

All the mechanics that we develop together in Hejstos will be transferred one to one to Farathan. The world will change, the main character will change, and a plot will be added.

So, all the work that we do together here is aimed at making playing Farathan enjoyable.

[h2]Farathan[/h2]

The biggest challenge after Hejstos will be creating living cities in the style of Gothic. We have huge problems with this.

Narratively and dialogue-wise, the game will very much resemble Gothic. I mean a certain style here. Nowadays, it would be described as wooden, but that's exactly the type of dialogues I wanted to write.
The biggest threat to the project, apart from the aforementioned cities, is the part of the dialogues and the possible need to rework and record them again, but we will assess this after Hejstos.

The premiere of Farathan will occur +/- half a year after the premiere of Hejstos. We will do everything to make the game as good as possible, but we expect sales to be around 2000 copies. We are talking about Farathan here. Hejstos is a small project for us gathered here.


[h2]About us[/h2]

We are a 2-person team, we love playing and making games.
We most enjoy creating games that are medieval fantasy and simply medieval.

We work as a duo because we are old enough to understand that working in large teams, in offices, is not for us. So, if you expect us to build another CD PROJEKT RED, unfortunately, that is not our ambition.

Our approach to players is modeled on Larian Studios (Creators of Baldur's Gate 3); we accept criticism and try to improve what you do not like. We do not take offense at anyone.

I am happy to listen to everything about the game, what you need, how a given mechanic should look. However, I do not discuss marketing and company development.

If you have any questions justk ask

Best regards,
Sartorian
